transcript:
Meeting Header:
Date: 2026-11-09
Time: 10:00 AM PT
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees: Avery (CEO), Marisol (CTO), Connor (VP Product), Janelle (Head Eng), Riley (Sales), Priya (CS), Ethan (Security), Samir (Infra), plus ~120 attendees on the call

Summary (auto):
Avery opened with quick wins and metrics: ARR trending up, net retention improving, committed Dedicated deals in flight. Marisol covered engineering highlights — significant latency improvements, new kernel selection heuristics, and ongoing private deployment work. Connor walked through product roadmap for Q4 and the Dedicated beta timeline. Ethan provided a compliance update and next steps for SOC2 and KMS/HSM integration. The call closed with an extended Q&A and reminders about the offsite and holiday schedule.

[00:00] Avery: okay good morning everyone, thanks for joining our November all hands. I know it’s a packed week so super appreciate it. quick housekeeping — recording on, please keep questions for the Q&A box, we’ll try to get to as many as possible.

[00:22] Avery: small win to start — revenue for the month is up 8% month over month, churn ticked down to 3.6% which is great. net retention sits at 118 for the quarter, so big thumbs up to sales and cs. Riley and Priya, huge thanks.

[01:05] Riley: yeah big credit to the AE and CS teams, also shout out to eng for the latency improvements we shipped in October that helped close a couple of enterprise deals, customers noticed.

[01:25] Marisol: hi everyone, engineering update — we shipped the kernel selector for transformer convs, there was some messy perf regression in the canary but we rolled back a small thing and it's stable now. overall token throughput improved ~22% on internal benchmarks, although sometimes the transcribe said 20, but it's 22. we also improved KV cache eviction heuristics — that reduced cold-start overhead. note: the transcript may say KV cash, it's KV cache.

[02:10] Janelle: on deployments, Private (VPC) installs have a faster onboarding flow now; the private control plane installer will detect k8s versions and pre-check common firewall rules. we still have a few edge cases for air-gapped installs — infra team is tracking.

[03:00] Connor: product roadmap highlights: Dedicated beta opens sign-ups next week, targets are: predictable throughput, per-route cost breakdowns in console, and automatic fallback routing policies. we prioritized model pinning and rollout controls for the beta — those are critical for enterprise customers doing canaries and A/B.

[03:45] Connor: also, Optimize (our cost/perf toolkit) is getting a pilot feature that suggests batching and quantization profiles per route; early results show up to 30% unit cost reductions on chat workloads.

[04:30] Avery: great. on go-to-market — focus this quarter is enterprise motion around Dedicated and Private, with an emphasis on compliance and audit readiness as a gating factor. Riley, quick note on pipeline?

[04:50] Riley: pipeline looks healthy; we've got three enterprise live-deals that would be Dedicated contracts — if those close, we'll hit our Q4 commit. continuing to get questions around SOC2 scope, SSO/SAML integrations, and proof of on-prem options.

[05:20] Ethan: security update — SOC2 audit kicked off last week, we've got the readiness docs up, and the first controls walkthrough is scheduled for 11/17. about KMS — customers are asking how to bring keys; we are finalizing HSM integration guidance and a FAQ that maps to common compliance questions.

[06:05] Samir: infra notes — Dedicated beta capacity plan: we expect to reserve an initial pool of A100s and H100s, plus a lightweight GPU pool for burst. we are still finalizing autoscaling tuning for multi-tenant Dedicated. also continuing work on the compilation heuristics; some models benefit from a different attention kernel.

[06:45] Marisol: a note on the runtime: we shipped a change that improves prefix caching behavior, which helps chat apps with long context. that has the side effect of slightly higher memory usage in edge cases — we've mitigations coming.

[07:20] Janelle: reliability — uptime last month 99.94% across hosted API, and we had a brief 8-minute disruption due to a failed kernel rollout in one region; rollout rollback safety is improved now.

[08:00] Connor: customer success and case studies — Priya, you want to talk about the top wins?

[08:10] Priya: sure, we shipped a major POC with a fintech customer using Private deployment for regulatory reasons — they loved the audit logs and per-token cost visibility. next step is to scale that POC into a pilot across two more lines of business. also, our churn reasons are mainly integration time and pricing confusion; we'll be working on clearer quickstart templates and pricing pages.

[09:00] Avery: hiring update, Talia?

[09:05] Talia: hiring remains a top priority — we opened 18 new roles across eng, infra, and sales. goal is to ramp headcount for Dedicated support and security. we’re consolidating interview loops to move candidates faster; also reminder to managers to review interview feedback within 48 hours.

[09:40] Avery: culture / offsite — head's up, end-of-year offsite is Dec 10–12; please RSVP. we’re doing a volunteer day on the 11th; details will come from Talia.

[10:00] Q&A (selected):
[10:05] Employee (chat): can you share more on Dedicated pricing?
[10:08] Connor: short answer — we'll publish beta pricing next week; it's a mix of reserved monthly commit plus per-token for overage, and per-GPU-hour reporting in the console. more details in the pricing doc we’ll share.

[10:40] Employee: what's the rollback policy for model updates in Dedicated?
[10:43] Marisol: model pinning is enforced at the route level for Dedicated; rollouts support canary and A/B with automatic fallback to a previous version if latency/error budget is breached. there was a little static in the transcript where it said 'model pin ball' — it's model pinning.

[11:10] Employee: status on on-prem air-gapped installs?
[11:13] Samir: progress good; we have a package that supports air-gapped installs but still ironing out HSM/KMS onboarding steps. customers doing on-prem want deterministic build artifacts; that's getting extra validation.

[11:45] Avery: okay, two quick asks — first, leadership to share the Q4 roadmap doc by end of day Monday; second, security to publish SOC2 summary and KMS guide. Please put those in next steps.

[11:55] Avery: final note — thanks everyone for the hard work, especially teams on the Dedicated pilot and SOC2. let's keep the momentum into the holidays and be mindful of burnout.

[12:00] Meeting ends

Notes about transcript quality: speakers sometimes overlap, microphone issues mid-call caused one section to be low SNR; product names occasionally mistranscribed (e.g., Redwood Optimize -> Red wood optimize, KV cache -> KV cash). This transcript retains natural speech patterns and occasional filler words.
